recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. The current source matches FHIR-39043; any future cleanup of now-unused package-characteristic example terminology should be handled only under a separate terminology/source-scope decision.
issue_request: FHIR-39043 was a Published/Persuasive PackagedProductDefinition change request to change characteristic from a single code to a Property-style type/value pair because a lone code can lack context.
initial_application: Commit 12352b4f1841aae5b81852de686e2058d9a96978 explicitly applied FHIR-39043 by removing the original CodeableConcept binding for PackagedProductDefinition.characteristic and adding a contentReference to PackagedProductDefinition.packaging.property.
additional_context: FHIR-26824 originally introduced the pack-level characteristic as a simple CodeableConcept. FHIR-31528 had already accepted the same type/value-pair pattern for MedicinalProductDefinition.characteristic and is already represented on the combined branch by an audit commit, so it was treated as related context rather than decided again.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. The active source already has PackagedProductDefinition.characteristic as 0..* and content-references PackagedProductDefinition.packaging.property, whose type and value[x] children implement the requested name/value pair.
